blocks.text: Two bodies have been recovered from the site of an avalanche that struck the Himlung Himal area of Manang on Sunday morning, but the victims have not yet been identified. Fourteen people were reported missing in the incident. Tul Singh Gurung, president of the Nepal National Mountain Guides Association (NNMGA), said a search and rescue team that travelled from Kathmandu to the Himlung area on Sunday recovered the bodies.
